review.notes: Triage review of all 36 physical pages. Full structural scan: no code fences (0 pairs), 24 image embeds for figures/screenshots. Automated normalized 4-gram containment of every PDF page's text layer against the OCR markdown; the low-containment pages (physical 3, 5, 7, 18, 28) all resolve to the preparedness/benchmark tables whose cells exist intact in the OCR's HTML tables - the PDF text layer interleaves table columns and hyphenates words at line breaks ('fre quency', 'cy ber ops'), while the OCR dehyphenates and reflows them (verified Table 2 pre/post-mitigation values 198/4.04%, 192/3.13%, 200/3.50%, 197/3.05%, 199/1.51%, 32/9.38%, 28/10.71%, 27/18.52%, 37/5.41%, 37/13.51% against the text layer, and p.7 StrongREJECT/targeted-red-teaming values 0.89/0.99/0.93, 0.47/0.24/0.62/0.50, 0.40/0.61/0.68/0.67). Physical p.3 was rendered (140 dpi, top 62%) and visually inspected to verify the one patch below and to confirm 'bio terror' is printed with a space in the source (kept unchanged); sibling hyphenated line breaks in the same table (societal, safeguards, cyberattacks, OpenAI, frequency) were all dehyphenated by the OCR, so only the header retained its layout hyphen. References [1]-[3+] present. Line-by-line review covered the diff contexts of flagged pages; the remaining pages matched the text layer, and this card has no page-bottom footnote class. Multi-line safeguard cells are flattened to single paragraphs with spaces, matching the OCR's treatment of every other cell in the document. Rendered physical p.3 top half at 140 dpi and read the PNG to confirm the header hyphenation and the spaced 'bio terror'.

patches.evidence: Rendered physical p.3 (140 dpi crop of the section 3.3 Preparedness table) prints the third column header on two lines as 'Associated Risk of Se-' / 'vere Harm' - a narrow-column layout hyphen. Every other hyphenated line break inside this table ('so-cietal', 'safe-guards', 'cyberat-tacks', 'Ope-nAI', 'fre-quency', 'de-ployment', 'invest-ment') was dehyphenated by the OCR; only this header kept the artifact hyphen, which would surface as a mid-word hyphen in the reflowed reader table. The patch joins it to 'Severe' like its siblings. 'bio terror' in the same table is printed with a space and was left unchanged.

unresolved.evidence: Benchmark and evaluation-description tables (Tables 1-6, section 5/6 eval-overview tables) were verified against the PDF text layer for values and captions, and physical p.3 was rendered for the header patch, but no table was compared cell-by-cell against a full-resolution render.
